scope: Verification candidate; in-process versus sidecar remains undecided.
Bounded Linux/amd64 feasibility only; no accepted production capability.

prerequisites.detail: G2 #38 recommends a bounded worker because Verify has no cancellation parameter. Production DA-001 execution, trust-policy and packaging gates remain incomplete.

licenses_notices.detail: Root Apache-2.0 and fixture rights inspected; Linux C ABI/CLI graph contains 153 pinned packages. Declared licenses do not establish per-file redistribution or packaging-notice clearance.

unit_contract.detail: 11 final byte/trust cases completed without mismatches. Six c2pa-rs-origin assets provide independent fixtures, not independent verifier execution; production adapter conformance remains untested.

live_adapter.detail: No production DA-001 verifier exchange. Rust C ABI, CLI and Go byte probe executions do not establish a completed sidecar protocol.

source_integrity.detail: Read-only fixtures retained unchanged file/buffer hashes; telemetry override cases left preferences unchanged. This does not validate production acquisition, manifest maps or raw-response identity enforcement.

adversarial_fuzz.detail: Cases distinguish invalid signatures, hash mismatch, unsigned input, trust status and the size boundary; an observed-live worker was terminated/reaped. No full verifier fuzz campaign or independent algorithm validation.

resources.detail: Rust build used 137.932 seconds wall, 113.642 CPU seconds and 648.3 MiB peak memory. Study used 2 GiB cgroup memory, 120-second case deadlines and a 32 MiB probe input cap; no production bound claimed.

native_platforms.detail: Rust/CLI/CGO verifier executed only on Linux amd64. Linux arm64/macOS untested; Windows linker/packaging requires investigation.

build_install.detail: Two clean Rust target directories produced matching static-library, shared-library and CLI hashes. CGO probe still requires system libraries/loader; offline installation, relocation and other platforms remain unvalidated.

disable_rollback_missing.detail: Worker termination/reaping was demonstrated, but no installed verifier adapter exists for disable, incompatible/missing runtime, rollback or uninstall drills.

security_updates.detail: Explicit telemetry-off overrides conflicting ambient settings in the study. Network isolation did not trace socket attempts; full transitive advisories, trust-update policy and security response review remain open.

semantic_upgrade.detail: 11 final verifier cases and the corrected exploratory trust-label mismatch are retained. No accepted verification baseline, new-pin semantic comparison or production rollback drill exists.

docs/reuse/evaluations/c2pa-verifier.md.purpose: Observed results, environment and residual limitations

docs/reuse/evaluations/c2pa-verifier/man.purpose: Exact retained experiment artifacts, toolchain and result identities

experiments/c2pa-verifier/README.md.purpose: Reproducible pinned provisioning and offline commands

limitations: Eleven final cases pass; independent fixture origin is not independent verifier execution.
Rust/CGO and system-library packaging tested only on Linux amd64.
Telemetry override and worker termination probes do not prove a production sandbox or cooperative cancellation.
next_actions: Finish #36 and a bounded worker implementation proposal.
Add independent verification, reviewed trust-profile cases and target-specific packaging evidence.
Obtain reviewed production test/platform/resource and license/security plans before adoption.
